title: Two calls per level make a tree: 2^n leaves, but the stack holds only one path
caption: The calls of build(prefix) for n = 3. Each call appends "0" or "1" and recurses; a prefix of length n is a leaf.

frames.text: build("") is the root call. It will call build("0") and then build("1").
Running build("010"): the call stack is exactly the path "" → "0" → "01" → "010". Space is the depth, n + 1 frames.
The leaves are the 2^3 = 8 finished strings. Time is the number of calls: 2^(n+1) − 1 = 15 nodes.
